premises: Defective carbon supports (e.g., turbostratic graphite) provide anchoring sites for nanoparticles
Anchoring occurs via intercalation of surface atoms at edge-plane defects
Hindered surface diffusion delays premelting and raises melting temperature
This mechanism applies to HEA nanoparticles below ~100 nm
